# The files whose change can change the pictures of scripts/screenshots.sh: after a
# change of main that touches one, the screenshot bot renders them anew. One pattern
# on each line, as the paths of a workflow: * within a folder, ** through folders, and
# one that starts with ! leaves files out. The script and this list count on their
# own. .github/workflows/visual.yml renders the pictures of a pull request on the same
# paths, which tests/e2e/compare.test.mjs keeps equal.

# The social preview.
.github/social-preview.html
.github/social-preview/Dockerfile
scripts/social-preview.sh

# The app as the pictures show it: its pages, scripts, styles, icons and texts, and its
# code, which writes the reports, the status and the files of the archive.
css/**
img/**
js/**
l10n/**
lib/**
templates/**

# household archive, the containers and fonts, and the image of Playwright in run.sh.
tests/e2e/screenshots.sh
tests/e2e/screenshots.mjs
tests/e2e/frozen.mjs
tests/e2e/files-address.mjs
